verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an email-infrastructure SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of retention policies, configurable retention windows, or deletion of messages, threads, or inboxes. SOC 2 compliance, pod isolation, scoped keys, and a community mention of Bring Your Own Cloud are adjacent privacy features, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
